name: Cheech & Chong - 6 Pack x 0.5g Cryo Infused Pre-Rolls - Bouncy Van
description:
Six joints, extra kick. The Cheech & Chong Bouncy Van 6-pack gives you six half-gram pre-rolls — 3 grams total — each packed with quality flower and cryo-infused with distillate for a bolder, more potent smoke. Perfectly portioned for shorter sessions, sharing, or keeping a few on hand.

Bouncy Van rolls out a bold, easygoing profile: sweet fruit and candy notes up front, grounded by an earthy, gassy backbone and a smooth finish. It's a fun, flavor-forward smoke built for good company and long rides — with an extra step up in strength.

Why you'll love it:

6 × 0.5G cryo-infused pre-rolls — 3 grams total, quality flower infused with distillate for extra potency
Perfectly portioned — right-sized for a quick session or passing around
Cryo-infusion process — locks in flavor and delivers a smooth, even burn
Signature Bouncy Van flavor — sweet fruit and candy with an earthy, gassy finish
Cheech & Chong — a name that's been in the game since day one

Big flavor, dependable potency, and effortless convenience in every pack. Cheech & Chong Bouncy Van is ready whenever you are.

For adult use only. Must be 21+. Keep out of reach of children and pets.
